articles.title: Tom Lee's BitMine ether holdings rise to 5.77 million tokens, or 4.8% of total supply
articles.snippet: The company expanded its ETH treasury while Chairman Tom Lee pointed to Robinhood Chain's rapid growth on Ethereum.

articles.title: Wall Street transfer agents lobby SEC, warning that third-party tokens pose risks to market integrity
articles.snippet: The Securities Transfer Association, an industry group for transfer agents, said company-authorized tokenization should receive preferential treatment under future rules.

articles.title: Profit-taking, MidEast hostilities drag crypto lower after bullish week
articles.snippet: Crypto's weekend gains gave way to a Monday selloff as Middle East tensions resurfaced, South Korea's Kospi lost 9.2% and $253 million in leveraged positions were wiped out.

articles.title: Bitcoin’s BIP 110 fork deadline nears with miner support at zero
articles.snippet: The BIP 110 proposal would cap arbitrary data on Bitcoin for a year, but Michael Saylor, Adam Back and others say turning a spam dispute into a consensus fight could create a bigger risk than the spam itself.

articles.title: Bitcoin threatens $62K in risk-asset rout as Donald Trump says US will 'run' closed Hormuz Strait
articles.snippet: Bitcoin bulls faced an uphill struggle to preserve $62,000 as stocks opened down on Strait of Hormuz rhetoric between the US and Iran.
